## Coursework and research

**Workout Tracking Application** (Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, spring 2026). The
semester deliverable for the Software Design course, built in Java by a multinational
student team. I wrote the logic that turns a JSON exercise catalog into a workout plan,
following a formal design process of requirements specification, design patterns, and
iterative review.

**Emergency department overcrowding research** (UAB Department of Health Services
Administration, summer 2025). I worked in Dr. Abdulaziz Ahmed's group on a federally
funded project to predict and simulate emergency-department overcrowding. I cleaned and
harmonized hospital datasets for feature engineering, prepared and debugged the Python
pipeline, and helped tune the machine-learning models.
